shortDescription.default: Search the ServiceNow catalog and submit requests from Microsoft 365 Copilot

longDescription.default: Copilot UX component and declarative agent that searches the ServiceNow Catalog Copilot connector, shows matching items in a grid and submits item request forms to ServiceNow with the signed-in user's Microsoft Entra ID token.
